preprint_evidence_quotes.quote: We examined associations between total meat, red meat, processed meat and poultry intake and incidence for 20 common cancer sites.

Processed meat intake was positively associated with the risk of colorectal cancer (HR per 20 g/day higher intake 1.18, 95%-CI 1.06-1.31, P trend = 0.0022; Fig 4 ) and rectal cancer (1.26, 1.06-1.51, P trend = 0.011; Fig 4 ).
Analyses restricted to men (n = 217,972).
The endpoints were first incident cancer diagnosis or cancer recorded in death certificates if no prior diagnosis was registered
